source_text: Benedixit et non avertam. Non est contra in Iacob; Dominus Deus eius cum eo. Gloria Christo in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: He-blessed and not I-will-turn-away. Not is enchantment against in Jacob; Lord God his with him. Glory to-Christ into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[He has blessed, and I will not reverse it >> Bible:Numbers 23:20]]. No spell against Jacob; the Lord his God is with him. Glory to Christ forever. Amen.
